title: Last night I dreamt about mall world food court
content: I was with my boyfriend in a food court at the mall. we were in line at baskin robins and the girl in front of us ordered a small ice cream with a sprinkle waffle cup. then she saw the small and said she’d better get a medium. then she said yea that looks better good thing I got the medium. then it was my turn to order, I got a medium cotton candy ice cream with sprinkle waffle cone. She put It in a regular cup and I had to ask for the sprinkle cup again. Then me and my boyfriend went into the dining room and almost every table was filled. We saw what we thought was a n empty seat but there was a not e that said RV will be right back! and then someone told us the seat was taken. Finally we found two empty seats together and sat down and ate or ice cream. Then a server came over with some fries but it was barely filled so I said it wasn’t enough even though I knew we didn’t order any fries. The server came back with 2 cheeseburgers and more fries. She left them at the table and some girl was staring at us because she knew that the food was hers. I was looking at the burgers and they had ketchup on them otherwise I would have eaten it. So we finished our ice cream and threw t he food out and left. next we were walking outside trying to come up with something else to do since it was the weekend. We thought about going to a live music bar but we had already eaten. We couldn’t think of anything to do
